Gimble's Dark Fantasy Kit Sampler (Free)
by Gimble's Games
Version 1.0

A free taste of the Gimble's Dark Fantasy Kit pixel art packs: 15 item icons, 10 status & HUD icons,
6 character portraits, 2 battle backgrounds and 13 UI kit pieces. Everything is made to fit together in one game.

WANT THE FULL SET?
  Dark Fantasy Item Icons — Gimble's Dark Fantasy Kit
    https://gimblesgames.itch.io/dark-fantasy-item-icons
  Dark Fantasy Status & HUD Icons — Gimble's Dark Fantasy Kit
    https://gimblesgames.itch.io/dark-fantasy-status-hud-icons
  Dark Fantasy Portraits — Gimble's Dark Fantasy Kit
    https://gimblesgames.itch.io/dark-fantasy-portraits
  Dark Fantasy Battle Backgrounds — Gimble's Dark Fantasy Kit
    https://gimblesgames.itch.io/dark-fantasy-battle-backgrounds
  Dark Fantasy UI Kit — Gimble's Dark Fantasy Kit
    https://gimblesgames.itch.io/dark-fantasy-ui-kit
  All five in the Gimble's Dark Fantasy Kit Bundle (save on the set):
    https://itch.io/s/217307/gimbles-dark-fantasy-kit-bundle

File names match the full packs, so you can swap in the full versions without renaming anything.

CONTENTS
  item_icons/32px  64px  128px            item icons on transparent backgrounds (64 and 128 are 2x / 4x copies)
  hud_icons/32px  64px  128px             status, interaction, map and HUD icons
  portraits/transparent/64px 128px 256px  portraits on transparent backgrounds
  portraits/framed/64px 128px 256px       portraits on a framed dark square, ready for dialogue boxes
  backgrounds/native_320x180 640x360 1280x720 1920x1080   two battle backgrounds (pixel-perfect 2x / 4x / 6x copies)
  ui/1x  ui/2x                            starter UI kit pieces: iron panel + tooltip, red button (4 states), bar, slots,
                                          2 cursors (9-slice margins and cursor hotspots in ui/ui_index.json; set your
                                          engine to TILE the middle parts, not stretch)
  palette/                                dark_fantasy_kit_icons_80 (icons, UI) and dark_fantasy_kit_portraits_64: .gpl / .hex
  index.csv / index.json                  every file with its name, type and the full pack it comes from

Hard pixel edges, no semi-transparent pixels. Scale further with nearest neighbour.

ABOUT HOW THESE WERE MADE
The icons, portraits and backgrounds were made with AI-assisted generation, then reviewed, re-rolled where needed,
snapped to a true pixel grid, unified to one palette and cleaned up by hand and by script. The UI pieces were drawn
in code, given an AI-assisted texture pass and made seamless by script.
